name: @mxlang/tsx-bridge
description: Finds MX regions inside TypeScript modules and splices their compiled output back in (the .solid.mx / .preact.mx / .react.mx bridge)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @mxlang/core --define process.env.BABEL_8_BREAKING=false --define process.env.USE_ESM=true --define process.env.IS_PUBLISH=true && bun scripts/emit-declarations.ts
